finding: The git options that keep a replace ref out of the trusted reads exist twice. `git_argv` of crap-score and `_hardened_git_text` of premerge-check each write `git -c core.useReplaceRefs=false --no-replace-objects` by hand. The code review of SEC-0009 already had to add `-c core.useReplaceRefs=false` to the first copy after `--no-replace-objects` alone proved not enough on git 2.34.1. A next change of the same kind must be made in both scripts, and no test compares them. Fix: premerge-check already imports dispatch_lib.py, and crap-score imports no module of the Factory. So the smallest change is one test in tests/factory/test_crap_gate_premerge.py that loads both scripts and asserts that `_hardened_git_text` runs git with the options of `git_argv`. A shared function in dispatch_lib.py would also remove the copy, but crap-score would then need that import.
why_this_severity: Both copies hold the same two options today, and the replace-ref probe passes for crap-score and for premerge-check (no to fails_purpose). A later change to the hardening, like the one the SEC-0009 review asked for, must find and change two scripts. The code exists only on feature/crap-gate-trusted-source.
